_comment: Windows standalone miniQMT targeted-pool bridge (legacy). For Tushare rt_k replacement use scripts/miniqmt_bridge.full_market.example.json and --universe full_market. Do not run targeted and full_market at the same time. CLI flags override these values. Only realtime-daily-k sink is implemented; minute-bars is reserved for the future. Copy this file to scripts/miniqmt_bridge.json for local use.
